title: Parser robustness: reduce smoke MalformedDocument skips on real pages
description:
## Why
SMOKE=1 zig build smoke currently skips 2/3 live pages (Wikipedia, MDN) because Page.navigate returns MalformedDocument. This is non-gating for current green but hides parser fragility on modern HTML.

## What
Investigate tokenizer/tree-builder/document normalization edge cases triggered by live pages and harden parse pipeline so smoke can parse at least the current fixture set without MalformedDocument skips.

## Acceptance
- Repro notes captured for current failures from tests/smoke/urls.json
- At least one concrete parser robustness fix lands with regression tests
- SMOKE=1 zig build smoke reduces MalformedDocument skips vs current baseline
- Marked non-gating for integration gates
